title: Implement task manager module
description: Create task_manager.py to handle task creation, updates, and listing from task_state.jsonl.
steps: Design JSONL task schema
Implement create/list/update functions
Set default path to task_state.jsonl

title: Build CLI interface to task manager
description: Create a script in scripts/ to allow listing, adding, or updating tasks from the command line.
steps: Add argparse parser
Implement list and add commands
Support status filtering and pretty print

title: Display task backlog in Cliff web interface
description: Create a web route and template to show active/paused/planned tasks from memory/development/task_state.jsonl.
steps: Load tasks from JSONL
Create route /tasks
Render tasks by status in HTML

title: project structure automated task during commits
description: Git commits should be done often.  We should update a document covering the project structure that Cliff can use for context at any point.  Tying to git should keep it up to date to feed into Cliff at any time.

title: Build a Context Classifier
description: Create a context classifier to route to the correct AI stack.
steps: My intention is for this to be the first stack to intercept any HMI communication and route it to the correct place.  We can skip it with specific activities such as scanning receipts or wherever the input is always known to go to a specific stack.

title: Implement Project Awareness (Phase 2)
description: Add full project awareness to Cliff AI by parsing goals, code structure, git commit history, and task list to support contextual next-step suggestions.
steps: "Parse README.md, project charter, and goals.json into structured project memory",
"Index and summarize codebase file tree with basic metadata",
"Extract and summarize recent Git commits with timestamps and diffs",
"Track tasks from task_list.json or markdown sources",
"Add middleware to chat window to inject project summary and next suggestions",
"Implement next-step recommender based on current goal/task diff"

title: Create and Standardize README Structure Across Cliff AI
description: Add consistent README.md files to key subdirectories explaining their purpose, key scripts, and integration role in the Cliff AI system.
steps: "Add root-level README.md with project overview and quickstart",
"Write README.md for cli_archiver/, development/, lab_manager/, llm_server/, memory/, memory/schemas/, scripts/, services/, voice_input/, web_server/",
"Update or rename models/README.txt to README.md",
"Add optional readme for web_server/templates/ if needed",
"Add README index or metadata file if web UI will auto-load docs"

title: Add Documentation Updater Script and Optional Git Hook
description: Create a tool to auto-summarize recent code and commit changes and update related README/changelog files. Optionally use a git hook to queue doc reminders.
steps: "Build scripts/update_project_docs.py to summarize commits and changes",
"Add script support for updating CHANGELOG.md and per-folder summaries",
"Optionally create .git/hooks/post-commit to warn or queue doc update tasks",
"Log all changes to memory/development/git_commit_summary.jsonl"
